10501.name: Written in Rock
10501.text:
Easy / Standard - Act 1
[skull]: -X. X is your location's column number.
[cultist]: -1. Place 1 resource on this card, as a scrap.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail, remove 1 scrap from this card.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, take 1 damage.
10501.backText:
Easy / Standard - Act 2
[skull]: -X. X is your location's column number.
[cultist]: -2. Place 1 resource on this card, as a switch.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, move the Mine Cart once.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, remove 1 switch from this card.

10502.name: Written in Rock
10502.text:
Hard / Expert - Act 1
[skull]: -X. X is twice your location's column number.
[cultist]: -3. If you succeed, place 1 resource on this card, as a scrap.
[tablet]: -4. Remove 1 scrap from this card.
[elder_thing]: -5. Take 1 damage.
10502.backText:
Hard / Expert - Act 2
[skull]: -X. X is twice your location's column number.
[cultist]: -3. If you succeed, place 1 resource on this card, as a switch.
[tablet]: -4. Move the Mine Cart once.
[elder_thing]: -5. Remove 1 switch from this card.

10503.name: Underground Survey
10503.text: Forced - When this agenda advances: Move all doom on it to the next agenda. [action] Draw the top card of the encounter deck: Move 1 resource from your location to the scenario reference card, as a scrap. If the enconter card just drawn was a [[Power]] treachery, gain 5 resources.
10503.backText:
Deal 2 damage to each investigator and 1 direct damage to each [[Ally] asset they control.
Reveal the Control Station location and move each surviving investigator to it.
Each investigator loses all of their clues.
Advance the act.

10504.name: Dangerous Ride
10504.text:
Locations with a story asset on them cannot be slid or swapped.
Each enemy gains the hunter keyword and resolves its hunter keyword an additional time during the enemy phase.
When an enemy moves, each adjacent location is considered to be connected to its location.
10504.backText: Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical or 1 mental trauma.

10505.name: Descent into the Mines
10505.text: Objective - At the end of the round, if each surviving investigator is at Control Station, advance. (Hint: Get to the Control Station before the agenda advances!)
10505.backText: Remove each [[Cave]] location from the game (discarding all enemies, tokens, and attachments at those locations). If River Hawthorne is in play but not under control of any investigator, remove them from the game. Each investigator loses all but 2 of their clues. If it is agenda 1a, advance the agenda directly to agenda 2a (do not resolve agenda 1b). Your search for supplies will help you navigate whatever is ahead. Flip the scenario reference card over to its other side, moving all scraps on it to that side, as switches. Read Scenario interlude: The Cave-In (page 10).

10506.name: The Underground Maze
10506.text: [fast] During your turn, spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Either slide a location into an empty adjacent space, or swap 2 adjacent locations. [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] resources: Slide a revealed location into an empty adjacent space. (Group limit once per round.) [action] If the Prismatic Shard story asset is at your location: Take control of it. Objective - Get to the Rail Exit! When the Mine Card enters Rail Exit, immediately advance.
10506.backText: Check the following: - If an investigator controls Simeon Atwood, (→R1). - If an investigator controls Leah Atwood, (→R2). - If Simeon Atwood is set aside or still in play and not under the control of an investigator, (→R3). - If Leah Atwood is set aside or still in play and not under the control of an investigator, (→R4). - If none of the above is true, (→R5).

10507.name: Mine Cart
10507.text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Move Mine Cart once. If it moves off the rail line, each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma. [reaction] When Mine Cart moves, spend 1 switch: Either cancel the move, or move an additional time. (Group limit twice per phase.)

10508.name: Control Station
10508.text: [fast] During your turn: Swap 2 adjacent [[Rail]] locations. (Group limit once per game.)
10508.backText: As an additional cost to enter Control Station, investigators at an adjacent location must spend 2[per_investigator] clues, as a group.

10509.name: Rail Exit
10509.text: Rail Exit cannot be slid or swapped.
10509.backText: Rail Exit cannot be slid or swapped.

10512.name: Alkaline Rail
10512.text: Forced - At the end of the round: Deal 1 horror to each investigator and [[Resident]] asset at Alkaline Rail.

10513.name: Warped Rail
10513.text: Forced - After the Mine Cart enters Warped Rail: Move the Mine Cart once.

10514.name: Sunken Rail
10514.text: Forced - After Sunken Rail is revealed: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded. The lead investigator draws that enemy.

10515.name: Forked Rail
10515.text: Forced - At the end of the round, if the Mine Cart is at Forked Rail: Discard 1 switch from the scenario reference card.

10516.name: Rail Bridge
10516.text:
X is Rail Bridge's column number.
[action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] resources: Place 1 resource on the scenario reference card, as a switch. (Group limit once per round.)

10517.name: Subterranean Beast
10517.text:
Hunter. Massive.
Subterranean Beast gets +3 [per_investigator] health.
If Subterranean Beast is ready and at the Mine Cart's location, the Mine Cart cannot move.
[action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Exhaust Subterranean Beast. It cannot ready this round.

10518.name: Burrowing Hybrid
10518.text: Hunter. Forced - After Burrowning Hybrid enters play, if the Mine Cart is facing a connecting location: Slide that location into an adjacent empty space. If you cannot, swap it with a location adjacent to it.

10519.name: Frenzied Miner
10519.text: Hunter. X is Frenzied Miner's column number. Forced - After Frenzied Miner attacks you: Deal 1 damage to each other investigator and [[Resident]] asset at this location.

10520.name: Cave-In
10520.text: Revelation - Attach Cave-In to the location the Mine Cart is facing. If you cannot, Cave-In gains surge. Forced - When the Mine Cart would move into attached location: Cancel the move and deal 2 damage to each investigator and [[Resident]] asset in the Mine Cart. [action]: Test [combat] or [agility] (2). If you succeed, discard Cave-In. An investigator at an adjacent location may trigger this ability.

10521.name: Wild Ride
10521.text: Revelation - Test [agility] (5). If you fail, put Wild Ride into play in your threat area. Forced - When the Mine Cart moves: Either move it 2 additional times, or deal 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror to each investigator, [[Ally]] asset, and [[Resident]] card they control. Discard Wild Ride.

10522.name: Prismatic Shard
10522.text:
Uses (4 brilliance).
[reaction] When a scenario card or weakness card effect would discard any number of cards from your hand, exhaust Prismatic Shard and spend 1 brilliance: Ignore that effect and draw that many cards, instead.

10523.name: Hemlock House
10523.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is your current floor number (to a minimum of 1).
[cultist]: -1. If your location is an enemy, exhaust it.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, heal 1 damage from the nearest enemy-location.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, and it is agenda 2a or 3a, after this test resolves, remove this token from the chaos bag and add it to the predation bag.
10523.backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is twice your current floor number (to a minimum of 2).
[cultist]: -2. If you succeed and your location is an enemy, exhaust it.
[tablet]: -4. If you fail, heal 1 [per_investigator] damage from the nearest enemy-location.
[elder_thing]: -5. If it is agenda 2a or 3a, after this test resolves, remove this token from the chaos bag and add it to the predation bag.

10524.name: The Predatory House
10524.text: Create a separate bag consisting of the following tokens: [cultist], [tablet], and [elder_thing]. (If you do not have a second bag, you can use a cup, bowl, or other opaque container.) This is the predation bag, and these are predation tokens. They are not chaos tokens. Then, add the following tokens to the predation bag based on the current day: - Day 1: Add [cultist], [cultist] to the predation bag. - Day 2: Add [cultist] to the predation bag. - Day 3: No change is made. Some abilities will instruct investigators to make a predation test. A predation test may cause the house to come alive and prey on the investigators. To resolve a predation test, reveal a random token from the predation bag and resolve the effects for that token as indicated on the other side of this card. Flip this card over and place it next to the scenario reference card.

10525.name: Eerie Silence
10525.backText:
Shuffle each copy of the set-aside Out of the Walls and Pulled In treacheries into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
Find the unsealed [[Dormant]] location nearest to the most investigators. Flip that location to its enemy-location side.
Find the set-aside The Predatory House story card and resolve its text.

10526.name: The House Stirs (v. I)
10526.text: Forced - When the mythos phase ends: Make a predation test. [fast] Either place 1 [per_investigator] of your clues on your location or remove a seal from it: Ready it and flip it over.
10526.backText: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Find the unsealed [[Dormant]] location nearest to the most investigators. Flip that location to its enemy-location side.

10527.name: The House Stirs (v.II)
10527.text: Forced - When the mythos phase ends: Make a predation test. [fast] Either place 1 [per_investigator] of your clues on your location or remove a seal from it: Ready it and flip it over.
10527.backText:
Find the unsealed [[Dormant]] location nearest to the most investigators. Flip that location to its enemy-location side.
Attach a set-aside Fire! treachery to the leftmost location on the highest floor. Shuffle each other copy of Fire! into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.

10528.name: Living Walls
10528.text: Forced - When the mythos phase ends: Make a predation test. [fast] Either place 1 [per_investigator] of your clues on your location or remove a seal from it: Ready it and flip it over.
10528.backText: Each surviving investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.

10529.name: Strange Infestation
10529.text: Clues cannot be discovered from locations with no investigators. [action] If your location is unsealed and [[Dormant]], investigators at that location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 resource on it, as a seal. Objective - At the end of the round, if a total of 7 locations are sealed and/or in the victory display, advance.
10529.backText:
If there are more seals in play than enemy-locations in the victory display:
Your efforts to suppress the strange infestation seem to have angered it. A noisome screech shakes the foundation of the house, and the air floods with a fetid stench of something awful down below.
Put the set-aside Shapeless Cellar enemy-location into play on the Cellar Floor, as close to the middle column as possible. Advance to the set-aside act 2a "The Heart of the House" and remove act 2a "Against the House" from the game.
If there are more enemy-locations in the victory display than seals in play:
The foundations of the house shake as another room threatens to collapse. If you bring this house down, the abomination that lives inside it won't survive long.
Advance to the set-aside act 2a "Against the House" and remove act 2a "The Heart of the House" from the game.

10530.name: Against the House
10530.text: Clues cannot be discovered from locations with no investigators. Objective - Bring this house down! If no locations are in play, immediately advance (this occurs before investigators would be defeated by not being at a location).
10530.backName: Fall of the House of Hemlock

10531.name: The Heart of the House
10531.text: Clues cannot be discovered from locations with no investigators. [action] If your location is unsealed and [[Dormant]], investigators at that location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 resource on it, as a seal. Forced - After an enemy-location attacks you: Move (one location at a time) to Shapeless Cellar. Objective - When the Shapeless Cellar is in the victory display, advance.
10531.backText: Flip each enemy-location to its location side. Place 1 resource, as a seal, on each unsealed [[Dormant]] location. (→R1) (page 18).

10532.name: Bedroom
10532.text:
X is 1 more than this location's floor number.
[reaction] After you place a seal on this location: Draw 1 card or gain 2 resources.

10533.name: Bedroom
10533.text:
X is 1 more than this location's floor number.
[reaction] After you place a seal on this location: Draw 1 card or gain 2 resources.

10534.name: Bedroom
10534.text:
X is 1 more than this location's floor number.
[reaction] After you place a seal on this location: Draw 1 card or gain 2 resources.

10535.name: Bedroom
10535.text:
X is 1 more than this location's floor number.
[reaction] After you place a seal on this location: Draw 1 card or gain 2 resources.

10536.name: Washroom
10536.text: [fast]: Move 1 clue on this location to the location directly below it. (Limit once per turn.)

10537.name: Washroom
10537.text: [fast]: Move 1 clue on this location to the location directly below it. (Limit once per turn.)

10538.name: Washroom
10538.text: [fast]: Move 1 clue on this location to the location directly below it. (Limit once per turn.)

10539.name: Library
10539.text: [reaction] After you discover the last clue from Library: You find a secret passage. Choose any location and place 1 horror token on it, as a secret passage. For the remainder of this scenario, each copy of Library is connected to the location with a secret passage, and vice versa. (Max once per game.)

10540.name: Library
10540.text: [reaction] After you discover the last clue from Library: You find a secret passage. Choose any location and place 1 horror token on it, as a secret passage. For the remainder of this scenario, each copy of Library is connected to the location with a secret passage, and vice versa. (Max once per game.)

10541.name: Parlor
10541.text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Deal 2 damage to an enemy at a connecting location. You may test [intellect] (4). If you succeed, deal 1 additional damage to that enemy. (Limit once per round.)

10542.name: Dining Room
10542.text: Forced - After you discover the last clue at this location: Discard 1 card at random from your hand.

10543.name: Foyer
10543.text: [fast] During your turn: Move (to a connecting location). (Limit once per turn.) [action]: Resign. You flee the house.

10544.name: Grappling Spawn
10544.text: Hunter. (Night [night]) Retaliate. Grappling Spawn gets +X health, where X is its current floor (to a minimum of +1 health).

10545.name: Out of the Walls
10545.text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail and... - ...your location is an enemy, take 1 damage and 1 horror. - ...your location is unsealed and [[Dormant]], flip it over. - ...your location is sealed, discard 1 card at random from your hand.

10546.name: Pulled In
10546.text: Revelation - If there are no enemy-locations in play, Pulled In gains surge. Otherwise, test [combat] (4). If you fail, choose the nearest enemy-location and move (one location at a time) to it. If you failed by 4 or more, the chosen enemy-location attacks you.

10547.name: Shapeless Cellar
10547.text: Massive. Retaliate. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Shapeless Cellar cannot be sealed or flipped. Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Shapeless Cellar: Shapeless Cellar attacks you. Forced - If there are no clues on Shapeless Cellar: Add it to the victory display.

10548.name: Little Sylvie
10548.text: [reaction] When Little Sylvie is discarded from your hand or deck: Play it (paying its cost). [reaction] When a scenario card effect would discard a card from your hand or deck, exhaust Little Sylvie: Place that card on top of your deck, instead.

10549.name: The Silent Heath
10549.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half the number of [[Insect]] enemies in play and in the victory display (rounded up).
[cultist]: -1. You may shuffle a non-[[Elite]] enemy in the victory display into the encounter deck.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, choose an [[Insect]] enemy at your location. It engages you and makes an immediate attack.
[elder_thing]: -2. If you are at a [[Lair]] location, reveal another token.
10549.backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X the number of [[Insect]] enemies in play and in the victory display.
[cultist]: -3. If you succeed, you may shuffle a non-[[Elite]] enemy in the victory display into the encounter deck.
[tablet]: -5. Ready the nearest [[Insect]] enemy. It moves and attacks as if it were the enemy phase.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you are at a [[Lair]] location, you automatically fail.

10550.name: Unsettling Silence
10550.text: Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda, if the Brood Queen enemy is set aside: Reveal tokens from the chaos bag equal to the number of [[Insect]] enemies in the victory display. If a [skull] or [auto_fail] token is revealed, spawn the set-aside Brood Queen enemy.
10550.backText:
Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an [[Insect]] enemy is discarded. The lead investigator draws that enemy.
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.

10551.name: Desolation (v.I)
10551.text: Each [[Insect]] enemy loses aloof. Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda, if the Brood Queen enemy is set aside: Reveal tokens from the chaos bag equal to the number of [[Insect]] enemies in the victory display. If a token with a symbol is revealed, spawn the set-aside Brood Queen enemy.
10551.backText: Each investigator who has not been eliminated is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.

10552.name: Desolation (v.II)
10552.text: Each [[Insect]] enemy loses aloof and patrol and gains hunter. Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda, if the Brood Queen enemy is set aside: Reveal tokens from the chaos bag equal to the number of [[Insect]] enemies in the victory display. If a token with a symbol is revealed, spawn the set-aside Brood Queen enemy.
10552.backText: Each surviving investigator who has not been eliminated is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.

10553.name: A Lost Legacy
10553.text: Objective - When the round ends, investigators at the Pearl Estate Ruins may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
10553.backText: Randomly put the three set-aside locations from the Horrors in the Rock encounter set into play, unrevealed, adjacent to the three starting locations as explained on page 20 of the Campaign Guide. Take the remaining set-aside locations (Salt Chamber, Larval Tunnel, and Crystal Nursery) along with the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Shuffle them together and randomly deal 1 card facedown beneath each location.

10554.name: Searching the Heath
10554.text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Draw the top card beneath your location. [fast] Investigators at your location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Look at the top card beneath your location. You may place that card on the bottom of its stack. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned and there are 1 or more Crystal Remains in the victory display, advance.
10554.backText: Check the number of Crystal Remains in the victory display. - If there are exactly 3 Crystal Remains, (→R1) (page 22). - Otherwise, (→R2) (page 22).

10555.name: Crystal Grove
10555.text: [action] Investigators at Crystal Grove spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Add a Crystal Remains you control to the victory display.

10556.name: Pearl Estate Ruins
10556.text: [action]: Resign. You leave the heath behind. Add all Crystal Remains you control to the victory display.

10557.name: Ashen Slope
10557.text: Forced - When you reveal Ashen Slope: Test [agility] (4). If you fail, take 2 damage.

10558.name: Salt Chamber
10558.text: Revelation - Put Salt Chamber into play adjacent to the location from which it was drawn ([codex] Ω) (page 21). [action] Investigators at Salt Chamber spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Draw the top card of the stack beneath Salt Chamber. (Group limit once per round.)

10559.name: Larval Tunnel
10559.text: Revelation - Put Larval Tunnel into play adjacent to the location from which it was drawn. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Colorless Larva and spawn it at this location ([codex] Ψ) (page 21). [reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy at Larval Tunnel: Draw the top card of the stack beneath this location. (Group limit once per round.)

10560.name: Crystal Nursery
10560.text: Revelation - Put Crystal Nursery into play adjacent to the location from which it was drawn ([codex] Ф) (page 21). [reaction] After you end your turn in Crystal Nursery, take 1 direct horror: Draw the top card of the stack beneath Crystal Nursery. (Group limit once per round.)

10561.name: Commanding Resonance
10561.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, choose a different option from the following, if able: - Take 1 damage. - Discard 1 card at random from your hand. - The nearest [[Insect]] enemy readies, moves (one location at a time) until it reaches your location, engages you, and makes an immediate attack.

10562.name: Defend the Nest
10562.text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (2). Increase the difficulty of this test by 1 for each [[Lair]] location in play. If you fail, place 1 doom on the nearest [[Insect]] enemy. (If you cannot, take 2 horror instead.)

10563.name: Colorless Larva
10563.text: Aloof. Forced - After Colorless Larva attacks: Defeat it.

10564.name: Brood Soldier
10564.text:
Aloof. Patrol ([[Cave]] location with clues).
While Brood Soldier is ready, its location gets +2 shroud.

10565.name: Brood Queen
10565.text: Spawn - ([codex] Σ) (page 21). Massive. Alert. [[Insect]] enemies at Brood Queen's location lose aloof. Brood Queen gets +1 fight for each other [[Insect]] enemy in play and +X [per_investigator] health, where X is the current day number.

10566.name: Crystal Remains
10566.text: Revelation - Put Crystal Remains into play in your play area. If Crystal Remains is defeated, shuffle it with the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and place them facedown in a stack beneath the nearest [[Lair]] location. Forced - When your turn begins: Take 1 damage or horror.

10567.name: Crystal Remains
10567.text: Revelation - Put Crystal Remains into play in your play area. If Crystal Remains is defeated, shuffle it with the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and place them facedown in a stack beneath the nearest [[Lair]] location. Forced - When your turn begins: Take 1 horror.

10568.name: Crystal Remains
10568.text: Revelation - Put Crystal Remains into play in your play area. If Crystal Remains is defeated, shuffle it with the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and place them facedown in a stack beneath the nearest [[Lair]] location. Forced - When your turn begins: Take 1 damage.

10569.name: The Lost Sister
10569.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half the number of revealed [[Cave]] locations in play (rounded up).
[cultist]: -1. If you succeed, heal 1 horror.
[tablet]: -2. If you are at a [[Cave]] location, treat this token's modifier as -4 instead.
[elder_thing]: -2. If an [[Abomination]] enemy is at your location, reveal another token.
10569.backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X the number of revealed [[Cave]] locations in play.
[cultist]: -1. If you succeed by 2 or more, heal 1 horror.
[tablet]: -4. If you are at a [[Cave]] location, treat this token's modifier as -6 instead.
[elder_thing]: -3. If an [[Abomination]] enemy is at your location, this test automatically fails instead.

10570.name: Into the Caves
10570.text: Cards at [[Dark]] locations use (Night [night]) effects. Cards at all other locations use (Day [day]) effects.
10570.backText: Spawn one of the set-aside Crustacean Hybrid enemies at the [[Coastal]] location nearest to the most investigators, (In the Light) side faceup. Each investigator at a [[Dark]] location must discard 1 card at random from their hand. Place doom on agenda 2a equal to the current day number.

10571.name: Darkness Closes In
10571.text: Cards at [[Dark]] locations use (Night [night]) effects. Cards at all other locations use (Day [day]) effects.
10571.backText: Each surviving investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.

10572.name: The Missing Sibling
10572.text: Forced - After the last clue is discovered from a [[Cave]] location: Put the top card of the Caverns deck into play adjacent to that location. Objective - Find Elizabeth Peters! If the investigators "found a torn dog leash" and "found a set of footprints," immediately advance.
10572.backText:
Choose a [[Coastal]] location (with no investigators, if able). Put the set-aside Fungal Cave location into play adjacent to the chosen location.
Put the top card of the Caverns deck into play, adjacent to the Fungal Cave. Repeat this until the Fungal Cave is connected to four locations, or the Caverns deck is empty.

10573.name: On the Trail
10573.text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues and choose an enemy at a connecting [[Dark]] location: Move that enemy to your location. Objective - When an investigator enters Fungal Cave, immediately advance.
10573.backText: Spawn the set-aside Limulus Hybrid at the Fungal Cave. Remove Helen Peters from the game. If Theo Peters is under the control of any investigator, ([codex] Σ) (page 25).

10574.name: Face to Carapace
10574.text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues and choose an enemy at a connecting [[Dark]] location: Move that enemy to your location. Objective - If Limulus Hybrid is defeated, immediately advance.

10575.name: Akwan
10575.text: [action]: Resign. You give up the search. If it is Day 1 or Day 2, Akwan gains: "[action]: Parley. You ask around the village about the coastal caves. Look at the top 3 cards of the Caverns deck. Return them to the top of the Caverns deck in any order."

10576.name: Suspended Graveyard
10576.text: [action] Take 1 horror: You dig through the bone-strewn moss covering the walls. Put the top card of the Caverns deck into play adjacent to this location. (Group limit once per game.)

10577.name: Hidden Cove
10577.text: [action] Investigators at Hidden Cove spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that the investigators "found a torn dog leash." Forced - After you fail a skill test while fighting at Hidden Cove: Take 1 damage.

10578.name: Weed-Choked Beach
10578.text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while attempting to evade at Weed-Choked Beach: Lose 1 action. Forced - When you would leave Weed-Choked Beach: Reveal a chaos token. If a [skull], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] is revealed, you must either cancel the effects of the move or discard an [[Item]] asset you control.

10579.name: Rocky Shoreline
10579.text: Forced - After you reveal Rocky Shoreline: Spawn a set-aside Crustacean Hybrid enemy at this location, (In the Light) side faceup.

10580.name: Underground Pools
10580.text: [action] Investigators at Underground Pools spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that the investigators "found a set of footprints." Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Underground Pools: Take 1 horror.

10581.name: Open Cave
10581.text: [fast] During your turn: Test [agility] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each ready enemy at this location. If you succeed, Open Cave loses the [[Dark]] trait until the beginning of the next investigation phase (all cards at this location to use (Day [day]) effects). (Group limit once per round.)

10582.name: Fungal Cave
10582.text: [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues from Fungal Cave: Heal 1 damage. (Group limit once per round.) Forced - At the end of the round: Each enemy at Fungal Cave heals 2 damage.
10582.backText: As an additional cost for you to enter Fungal Cave, investigators at your location must spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.

10585.name: Cavern Moss
10585.text: Aloof. Hunter. While Cavern Moss is attached to an asset, it may be attacked as if it were an enemy engaged with you. Forced - After you succeed at a skill test while fighting or investigating at Cavern Moss's location, if it is ready: Attach Cavern Moss to an [[Item]] asset you control. Treat attached asset's text box as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]).

10586.name: Reclaimed by Nature
10586.text: (Day [day]) Revelation - Test [combat] (3). If you fail, you must either take 2 damage or choose the nearest enemy. That enemy attacks you. (Night [night]) Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, you must either take 2 horror, or each enemy at your location and each connecting location heals 1 damage.

10587.name: Luminous Growth
